sample_1.proposal:
**Proposed Website UI and Report Layout for Biological Age**
Prepared by BioHealthy for Maple Grove Clinics.

**Doctor- and nurse-facing web page**
The doctor or nurse sees the key tests of the Biological Age panel.
- The test name, result value and unit
- The normal range, where the test has one
- A status label, such as "Slower pace"
- The panel of the test

The nurse will manually key in the data for **Aging Tempo** and **Cellular Age Index**.
The status label for **Aging Tempo** is Slower pace, Average pace and Faster pace.
The status label for **Cellular Age Index** is Younger, Similar and Older.

[Picture: Website UI]

**Patient report layout**
For **Aging Tempo**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of < 1, and a one-line summary of the result.
For **Cellular Age Index**, the report displays the result value with its unit, no normal range, so none is shown, and a one-line summary of the result.

A recommendation appears only for abnormal results, as follows:
- Aging Tempo - Faster pace - Please talk to your doctor about actions you can take to slow down the pace.
- Cellular Age Index - Older - Please talk to your doctor about your result.

**Aging Tempo** shows its results from the latest three sessions, if available.
**Cellular Age Index** shows its results from the latest three sessions, if available.

[Picture: Report Layout]

sample_2.proposal:
**Proposed Website UI and Report Layout for Kidney Health**
Prepared by BioHealthy for LiveFull Health.

**Doctor- and nurse-facing web page**
The doctor or nurse sees the key tests of the Kidney Health panel.
- The test name, result value and unit
- The normal range, where the test has one
- A status label, such as "Normal"
- The panel of the test

The results for **eGFR (kidney filtration)** and **Serum creatinine** sync in automatically from the lab.
The status label for **eGFR (kidney filtration)** is Normal, Mildly reduced and Reduced.
The status label for **Serum creatinine** is Normal, Slightly high and High.

[Picture: Website UI]

**Patient report layout**
For **eGFR (kidney filtration)**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of >= 90, and a one-line summary of the result.
For **Serum creatinine**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of 45 - 90, and a one-line summary of the result.

A recommendation appears only for abnormal results, as follows:
- eGFR (kidney filtration) - Mildly reduced - Drink enough water and talk to your doctor about your kidney results.
- eGFR (kidney filtration) - Reduced - Drink enough water and talk to your doctor about your kidney results.
- Serum creatinine - Slightly high - Drink enough water and talk to your doctor about your kidney results.
- Serum creatinine - High - Drink enough water and talk to your doctor about your kidney results.

**eGFR (kidney filtration)** shows its results from the latest three sessions, if available.

[Picture: Report Layout]

- A status label, such as "Poor"
- The panel of the test

The nurse will manually key in the data for **Mind-Gut Link**, **Defence Balance**, **Energy Balance** and **Nutrient Processing**.
The status label for **Mind-Gut Link** is Poor, Good and Great.
The status label for **Defence Balance** is Poor, Good and Great.
The status label for **Energy Balance** is Poor, Good and Great.
The status label for **Nutrient Processing** is Poor, Good and Great.

For **Mind-Gut Link**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of 5 - 10, and a one-line summary of the result.
For **Defence Balance**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of 5 - 10, and a one-line summary of the result.
For **Energy Balance**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of 5 - 10, and a one-line summary of the result.
For **Nutrient Processing**, the report displays the result value with its unit, the normal range of 5 - 10, and a one-line summary of the result.

A recommendation appears only for abnormal results, as follows:
- Mind-Gut Link - Poor - Eat more fibre and plant foods, sleep 7 to 8 hours, and talk to your doctor.
- Defence Balance - Poor - Eat more colourful, antioxidant-rich foods and talk to your doctor.
- Energy Balance - Poor - Eat more fibre and plant foods and talk to your doctor.
- Nutrient Processing - Poor - Eat more fibre and plant foods and talk to your doctor.
